history.title: Events & History
history.subtitle: From a first night in Tashkent to a regional habit — the story so far.
history.founding_body: AI Qadam was founded in November 2025 as a non-profit community of AI practitioners in Central Asia. The first public event followed on 25 April 2026 in Tashkent.
history.growth_body: Community, show-rate, and partner reach have grown meetup over meetup — 158 sign-ups and +78 NPS at #1, 142 sign-ups and a 70% show rate at #2.
history.roadmap_body: Meetup #3 (September, pro sound + livestream), the first hackathon (Q4), the Kazakhstan chapter launch, and Uzbek-language events.

partners.title: Partner With Us
partners.subtitle: Partners invest in the community — they don't buy the audience.
partners.tier_one_off_body: Back a single event — venue, catering, prize pool, infra.
partners.tier_monthly_body: Steady monthly support, in cash or in kind.
partners.tier_annual_body: A yearly commitment tied to a stream or a chapter launch.
partners.regulator_body: Anonymized industry insight, a talent pipeline for national programs, a neutral dialogue venue, and joint research — while the community stays independent.
partners.cta_heading: Let's build the region's AI community together
partners.cta_body: Talk to Viktor directly about sponsoring a night or backing a stream.
